description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveStatusChangeEmailProcessor class, which handles processing email notifications related to leave status changes within the OrangeHRM HR management system. The class provides methods to generate replacement variables for email templates and determine recipients based on leave status change events.

classes.name: LeaveStatusChangeEmailProcessor
classes.description: A class responsible for processing email notifications related to leave status changes, including preparing email replacements and determining recipients based on leave change events.

methods.name: getReplacements
methods.description: Generates replacement variables for email templates based on a leave status change event, recipient, and performer roles.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Determines the list of email recipients based on the event type and recipient role.

methods.name: verifyLeavesFromOneLeaveRequest
methods.description: Ensures that all leaves in the provided array belong to a single leave request, throwing an exception if not.
